utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s lock in the drop-off time first, then I’ll get the word out and keep the repair-drive details moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need to set the jobs and a meeting time. Any help with setup, carrying items, or basic repairs would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — the community center loading entrance on Maple, got it. I’ll probably need the next place too, if you don’t mind.

utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring the tools over for the repair drive soon, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s set, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — we’re just nailing down the time and what we still need. I’ll keep everyone posted as it gets settled.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — I can keep track of the supplies and help sort out what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Could you keep it simple and lay out the jobs for the repair drive, then we can meet Saturday at 10 a.m. to go over it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll make a simple list of the jobs and bring it Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s lock in the community hall drop-off time first, and then I can firm up the repair drive timing. What works for you, Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center still works for me—let’s set the drop-off time first, and I’ll keep the repair drive timing lined up.
